supersession_reason: The Gate 1 approval manifest is non-signable (signing_permitted:false) and its embedded genesis_settlement_authorization_subject names campaign_id "pvt9_genesis_pending", the pre-arming campaign name. The live campaign is "pvt9_genesis_v1". The Gate 1 artifact is therefore structurally incapable of authorizing settlement for the campaign that exists, and is superseded FOR THE SETTLEMENT EPOCH-ZERO PIN ONLY. It remains byte-identical, remains the Gate 1 evidence of record, and remains the artifact bound by the Genesis runtime activation route. Nothing else moves.
supersession_does_not_grant: This manifest grants no deployment, activation, mint, settlement, transaction, admin, owner, proxy, executor, timelock, or governance authority. It authorizes exactly one artifact: the epoch-zero Genesis settlement budget policy event described below. It does not open the record-time monetary policy rail (verifyCurrentPvtManifestApproval), which reads the Gate 1 constant and stays refused.

decided_settlement_economics.note: Recorded, not chosen. Every value below EQUALS the existing ratified literal in proposed-genesis-policy.ts and the armed on-chain epoch-zero policy; none is a new economic decision.

signature_protocol.signed_over: the exact bytes of this file, unmodified
signature_protocol.note: No signature is stored in the repository. The signature lives in the Firestore epoch-zero policy event and is produced by Frank at emission time. Until that event exists and verifies, loadAuthorizedGenesisSettlementPolicyEvent refuses and no settlement is possible.
